tag.name: Community
tag.description:
##### Endpoints for community data. This category includes 2 endpoints:
- [/v1/community/trending/topic](/pro-api-reference/community#community-trending-topics) - Community Trending Topics
- [/v1/community/trending/token](/pro-api-reference/community#community-trending-tokens) - Community Trending Tokens

operations.description:
Returns the latest trending tokens from the CMC Community.

  
  **This endpoint is available on the following [API plans](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/pricing/):**
  - Standard
  - Professional
  - Enterprise

**Cache / Update frequency:** One Minute
**Plan credit use:** 0 credit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optionally specify the number of results to return.
